focus: Ponytail hook lifecycle, state, and portability mechanisms versus sk-code adapters

label: NEW: Give the Claude and Codex PostToolUse quality adapters a short adapter-local stdin deadline and an open-stdin regression case. Ponytail exits on normal EOF and forces exit after a referenced one-second fallback, with tests for the fast EOF path and self-exit before an external watchdog; sk-code's adapters read stdin to EOF and rely on each host's 10-second timeout. This narrows the failure window for a wrapper that fails to close stdin without changing the fail-open policy.
